text:
nina.devex: Quick sync — are we on track for the SDK + sample apps release this Friday? Changelog cutoff is EOD Thu. I need owners for: sample app publish, docs smoke test, changelog bullets, and final CI gating. Any blockers?

sam.eng: I’m green on the SDK itself, but blocked on the runtime API rename (param `max_tokens` -> `max_output_tokens`) — tariq.runtime was going to land a compat shim. @tariq.runtime?

tariq.runtime: Working on the shim now, ETA tomorrow 11am PT. Will open PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4321 and add an integration test.

maria.docs: Docs freeze scheduled for Thu 6pm PT. I need the final sample app README + the CLI usage snippet (node/python examples) before then. If Sam can drop the snippet I'll slot it in.

sam.eng: pushing a quick example now. snippet: ```js
// SDK quickstart
const Redwood = require('@redwood/sdk');
const c = new Redwood.Client({apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY});
await c.generate({model: 'rw-1-small', prompt: 'hello'});
```

kevin.qa: I’ll run smoke tests Wed night. Test matrix: node 16/18, python 3.9/3.10, linux/macos. Need CI job name to hook into.

ci-bot: Pipeline queued for runtime PR 4321 — integration tests started. Windows job failing on flake: `test-streaming-timeouts`.

sam.eng: noted, I’ll look at the windows flake this afternoon and push a fix.

olga.product: For the changelog, I’ll call out: API parameter rename (compat shim), new `smart_batching` opt, streaming stability fixes. I’ll draft bullets once Sam confirms snippet and Tariq confirms shim.

nina.devex: Ownership summary (please confirm): Sam = SDK + sample app publish; Maria = docs freeze & changelog collate; Kevin = QA smoke & release checklist; Tariq = runtime shim & PR; Olga = product bullets & release blurb.

sam.eng: Confirmed.

maria.docs: Confirmed — I’ll open the docs PR once the README snippet is in.

kevin.qa: Confirmed. Will post a short checklist in the morning.

tariq.runtime: Confirmed. PR will include compatibility tests.

olga.product: Confirmed, will post draft changelog bullets by EOD Wed.

nina.devex: Great. If we don’t have blockers by 11am PT tomorrow we’ll do a final readiness sign-off in this thread. Please ping here with any last-minute issues. :thumbsup:

sam.eng: ping if tests still fail after my fix.

ci-bot: runtime PR 4321 — integration passed on linux/mac, windows re-run queued.

nina.devex: Thanks all — logging this as the release readiness thread. I’ll circle back with a one-line signoff once CI + QA green.
